US Senate passes bipartisan AI safety bill 68-31, establishing federal licensing requirements for frontier model training runs https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/us-senate-ai-safety-bill

The AI safety bill now heads to the House, where leadership says a floor vote is expected before the October recess. White House has signaled the president will sign. https://apnews.com/article/senate-ai-bill-passage-2026
Notable: the Senate AI bill's licensing threshold was raised 10x in the final amendment, exempting nearly all academic labs. Full text: https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/3847

Ukraine and Russia conclude the third round of Istanbul ceasefire talks with no agreement, but both delegations say a fourth round is scheduled for September https://www.ft.com/content/ukraine-russia-istanbul-talks-third-round
Per two sources in the Ukrainian delegation: the sticking point in Istanbul remains sequencing — sanctions relief before or after withdrawal verification. No joint statement expected.
